title: Mosey Bank page sent for review
description: Sent by the site (src/lib/mark/triggers.ts) once per submission, when a person sends a page for review.

contentKey.description: The page's content key; pass it to mosey_get_review_context as page.

version.description: Version number of the submitted version; pass it to mosey_get_review_context as version.

url.description: Public URL of the page (the submitted version is not live yet).

previewUrl.description: Signed link that shows the submitted version without a CMS sign-in.

triggeredBy.description: The CMS user who submitted it.

status.description: Graph status of the version: InReview, or Ready when MARK_REVIEW_STATUSES includes it.

docId.description: The Graph document id the event carried: {guid}_{version}_{locale}_InReview.
